notes: Not checked against a purchased copy of ISO 9409-1:2004; dimensions marked unverified must be measured before use.
This part does not claim conformance with ISO 9409-1.
Robot side: fit 4 x M6x10 socket head cap screws from the tool face; each engages 6.5 mm of the flange thread.

No standard M6 length gives 9 mm (1.5 x d) of engagement within the 8 mm depth limit, so the screw was chosen with the 1.0 x d rule for a steel screw in a steel thread. Check the flange material before use.
Tool side: the M5 pilot holes are blind, for heat-set inserts or tapping.
Mass assumes a uniform 100% fill of PLA at 1.24 g/cm3; real prints have denser walls.
ISO 9409-1-31.5-4-M5: one secondary source lists this pattern as M6; three primary sources give M5.
